assumption: For ingestion planning, assume the user has already obtained permission from relevant dataset compilers and representatives for personal/research use and presentation to LEGO.
handling: Do not exclude a potentially useful research source solely because its public license would normally require additional review.
Still preserve original public license/terms and the asserted permission record as separate provenance fields.
Do not automatically infer public redistribution or unrelated commercial deployment rights from research/personal permission.
Prioritize informational completeness while keeping provenance auditable.
